texts.amo.1.1: The words of Amos, who was among the herdmen of Tekoa, which he saw concerning Israel in the days of Uzziah king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam the son of Joash, king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.
texts.amo.1.2: And he said, Jehovah roareth from Zion, and uttereth his voice from Jerusalem; and the pastures of the shepherds mourn, and the top of Carmel withereth.
texts.amo.1.3: Thus saith Jehovah: For three transgressions of Damascus, and for four, I will not revoke [my sentence], because they have threshed Gilead with threshing instruments of iron.
texts.amo.1.4: And I will send a fire into the house of Hazael, and it shall devour the palaces of Ben-Hadad.
texts.amo.1.5: And I will break the bar of Damascus, and cut off the inhabitant from the valley of Aven, and him that holdeth the sceptre from Beth-Eden; and the people of Syria shall go into captivity unto Kir, saith Jehovah.
texts.amo.1.6: Thus saith Jehovah: For three transgressions of Gazah, and for four, I will not revoke its sentence; because they carried away captive the whole captivity, to deliver [them] up to Edom.
texts.amo.1.7: And I will send a fire on the wall of Gazah, and it shall devour the palaces thereof.
texts.amo.1.8: And I will cut off the inhabitant from Ashdod, and him that holdeth the sceptre from Ashkelon, and I will turn my hand against Ekron; and the remnant of the Philistines shall perish, saith the Lord Jehovah.
texts.amo.1.9: Thus saith Jehovah: For three transgressions of Tyre, and for four, I will not revoke its sentence; because they delivered up the whole captivity to Edom, and remembered not the brotherly covenant.
texts.amo.1.10: And I will send a fire on the wall of Tyre, and it shall devour the palaces thereof.
texts.amo.1.11: Thus saith Jehovah: For three transgressions of Edom, and for four, I will not revoke its sentence; because he pursued his brother with the sword, and cast off all pity; and his anger did tear continually, and he kept his wrath for ever.
texts.amo.1.12: And I will send a fire upon Teman, and it shall devour the palaces of Bozrah.
texts.amo.1.13: Thus saith Jehovah: For three transgressions of the children of Ammon, and for four, I will not revoke its sentence; because they ripped up the women with child of Gilead, that they might enlarge their border.
texts.amo.1.14: And I will kindle a fire in the wall of Rabbah, and it shall devour the palaces thereof, with shouting in the day of battle, with a tempest in the day of the whirlwind.
texts.amo.1.15: And their king shall go into captivity, he and his princes together, saith Jehovah.
texts.amo.2.1: Thus saith Jehovah: For three transgressions of Moab, and for four, I will not revoke its sentence; because he burned the bones of the king of Edom into lime.
texts.amo.2.2: And I will send a fire upon Moab, and it shall devour the palaces of Kerijoth; and Moab shall die with tumult, with shouting, [and] with the sound of the trumpet.
texts.amo.2.3: And I will cut off the judge from the midst thereof, and will slay all the princes thereof with him, saith Jehovah.
texts.amo.2.4: Thus saith Jehovah: For three transgressions of Judah, and for four, I will not revoke its sentence; because they have despised the law of Jehovah, and have not kept his statutes; and their lies have caused them to err, after which their fathers walked.
texts.amo.2.5: And I will send a fire upon Judah, and it shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem.
texts.amo.2.6: Thus saith Jehovah: For three transgressions of Israel, and for four, I will not revoke its sentence; because they have sold the righteous for silver, and the needy for a pair of shoes;
texts.amo.2.7: panting after the dust of the earth on the head of the poor, and turning aside the way of the meek; and a man and his father will go in unto the [same] maid, to profane my holy name.
texts.amo.2.8: And they lay [themselves] down by every altar upon clothes taken in pledge, and they drink [in] the house of their God the wine of the condemned.
texts.amo.2.9: But I destroyed the Amorite before them, whose height was as the height of the cedars, and he was strong as the oaks; but I destroyed his fruit from above, and his roots from beneath.
texts.amo.2.10: And I brought you up from the land of Egypt, and led you forty years in the wilderness, to possess the land of the Amorite.
texts.amo.2.11: And I raised up of your sons for prophets, and of your young men for Nazarites. Is it not even thus, ye children of Israel? saith Jehovah.
texts.amo.2.12: And ye gave the Nazarites wine to drink; and commanded the prophets, saying, Prophesy not.
texts.amo.2.13: Behold, I will press upon you, as a cart presseth that is full of sheaves.
texts.amo.2.14: And flight shall perish from the swift, and the strong shall not strengthen his force, neither shall the mighty deliver his soul.
texts.amo.2.15: Neither shall he stand that handleth the bow; and the swift of foot shall not escape, and he that rideth the horse shall not deliver his soul;
texts.amo.2.16: and he that is stout-hearted among the mighty shall flee away naked in that day, saith Jehovah.
texts.amo.3.1: Hear this word that Jehovah hath spoken against you, children of Israel, against the whole family that I brought up from the land of Egypt, saying,
texts.amo.3.2: You only have I known of all the families of the earth; therefore will I visit upon you all your iniquities.
texts.amo.3.3: Shall two walk together except they be agreed?
texts.amo.3.4: Will a lion roar in the forest when he hath no prey? Will a young lion cry out of his den if he have taken nothing?
texts.amo.3.5: Can a bird fall in a snare upon the earth when no gin [is laid] for him? Will the snare spring up from the earth when nothing at all hath been taken?
texts.amo.3.6: Shall a trumpet be blown in the city, and the people not be afraid? Shall there be evil in a city, and Jehovah not have done [it]?
texts.amo.3.7: But the Lord Jehovah will do nothing, but he revealeth his secret unto his servants the prophets.
texts.amo.3.8: The lion hath roared, -- who will not fear? The Lord Jehovah hath spoken, -- who can but prophesy?
texts.amo.3.9: Publish in the palaces at Ashdod, and in the palaces in the land of Egypt, and say, Assemble yourselves upon the mountains of Samaria, and behold the great uproar in the midst thereof, and the oppressions that are within her:
texts.amo.3.10: and they know not to do right, saith Jehovah, who store up violence and plunder in their palaces.
texts.amo.3.11: Therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah: An adversary! -- even round about the land! And he shall bring down thy strength from thee, and thy palaces shall be pillaged.
texts.amo.3.12: Thus saith Jehovah: Like as the shepherd rescueth out of the jaw of the lion two legs, or a piece of an ear; so shall the children of Israel be rescued that sit in Samaria in the corner of a couch, and upon the damask of a bed.
texts.amo.3.13: Hear ye, and testify in the house of Jacob, saith the Lord Jehovah, the God of hosts,
texts.amo.3.14: that in the day that I shall visit the transgressions of Israel upon him, I will also punish the altars of Bethel; and the horns of the altar shall be cut off, and fall to the ground.
texts.amo.3.15: And I will smite the winter-house with the summer-house; and the houses of ivory shall perish, and many houses shall have an end, saith Jehovah.
texts.amo.4.1: Hear this word, ye kine of Bashan, that are in the mountain of Samaria, that oppress the poor, that crush the needy, that say to their lords, Bring, and let us drink:
texts.amo.4.2: the Lord Jehovah hath sworn by his holiness, that behold, days shall come upon you, when he will take you away with hooks, and your posterity with fish-hooks;
texts.amo.4.3: and ye shall go out by the breaches, every one straight before her, and ye shall be cast out to Harmon, saith Jehovah.
texts.amo.4.4: Come to Bethel, and transgress; at Gilgal multiply transgression; and bring your sacrifices in the morning, your tithes every three days,
texts.amo.4.5: and burn a thank-offering with leaven, and proclaim, publish, voluntary offerings: for this pleaseth you, children of Israel, saith the Lord Jehovah.
texts.amo.4.6: And I also have given you cleanness of teeth in all your cities, and want of bread in all your places; yet ye have not returned unto me, saith Jehovah.
texts.amo.4.7: And I also have withholden the rain from you, when there were yet three months to the harvest; and I caused it to rain upon one city, and caused it not to rain upon another city: one piece [of land] was rained upon, and the piece whereupon it rained not withered.
texts.amo.4.8: And two, three, cities wandered unto one city, to drink water, and were not satisfied: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith Jehovah.
texts.amo.4.9: I have smitten you with blasting and mildew; the palmer-worm hath devoured the multitude of your gardens, and your vineyards, and your fig-trees and your olive-trees: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith Jehovah.
texts.amo.4.10: I have sent among you the pestilence after the manner of Egypt: your young men have I slain with the sword, taking away captive your horses; and I made the stench of your camps to come up, even into your nostrils: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith Jehovah.
texts.amo.4.11: I have overthrown among you, like God's overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah, and ye were as a brand plucked out of the burning; yet have ye not returned unto me, saith Jehovah.
texts.amo.4.12: Therefore thus will I do unto thee, O Israel: because I will do this unto thee, prepare to meet thy God, O Israel.
texts.amo.4.13: For behold, he who formeth the mountains, and createth the wind, and declareth unto man what is his thought, who maketh the morning darkness, and treadeth upon the high places of the earth, -- Jehovah, the God of hosts, is his name.
texts.amo.5.1: Hear this word, a lamentation, which I take up against you, O house of Israel.
texts.amo.5.2: The virgin of Israel is fallen; she shall no more arise: she is cast down upon her land; there is none to raise her up.
texts.amo.5.3: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah: The city that went forth a thousand shall have a hundred left, and that which went forth a hundred shall have ten left, for the house of Israel.
texts.amo.5.4: For thus saith Jehovah unto the house of Israel: Seek ye me, and ye shall live.
texts.amo.5.5: And seek not Bethel, neither go to Gilgal, and pass not to Beer-sheba; for Gilgal shall surely go into captivity, and Bethel shall come to nought.
texts.amo.5.6: Seek Jehovah, and ye shall live; lest he break out like fire in the house of Joseph, and devour [it], and there be none to quench [it] in Bethel.
texts.amo.5.7: Ye who turn judgment to wormwood, and cast down righteousness to the earth,
texts.amo.5.8: [seek him] that made the Pleiades and Orion, and turneth the shadow of death into the morning, and maketh the day dark with night; that calleth for the waters of the sea, and poureth them out upon the face of the earth: Jehovah is his name.
texts.amo.5.9: He causeth destruction to break forth suddenly upon the strong, and bringeth destruction upon the fortress.
texts.amo.5.10: They hate him that reproveth in the gate, and they abhor him that speaketh uprightly.
texts.amo.5.11: Forasmuch, therefore, as ye trample upon the poor, and take from him presents of wheat: ye have built houses of hewn stone, but ye shall not dwell in them; ye have planted pleasant vineyards, and ye shall not drink the wine of them.
texts.amo.5.12: For I know how manifold are your transgressions and your sins mighty: they afflict the just, they take a bribe, and they turn aside [the right of] the needy in the gate.
texts.amo.5.13: Therefore the prudent shall keep silence in this time; for it is an evil time.
texts.amo.5.14: Seek good, and not evil, that ye may live; and so Jehovah, the God of hosts, shall be with you, as ye say.
texts.amo.5.15: Hate evil, and love good, and establish judgment in the gate: it may be that Jehovah, the God of hosts, will be gracious unto the remnant of Joseph.
texts.amo.5.16: Therefore thus saith Jehovah, the God of hosts, the Lord: Wailing shall be in all broadways; and they shall say in all the streets, Alas! alas! And they shall call the husbandman to mourning, and such as are skilful of lamentation to wailing.
texts.amo.5.17: And in all vineyards shall be wailing; for I will pass through the midst of thee, saith Jehovah.
texts.amo.5.18: Woe unto you that desire the day of Jehovah! To what end is the day of Jehovah for you? It shall be darkness and not light:
texts.amo.5.19: as if a man fled from a lion, and a bear met him; or went into the house and leaned his hand on the wall, and a serpent bit him.
texts.amo.5.20: Shall not the day of Jehovah be darkness, and not light? even very dark, and no brightness in it?
texts.amo.5.21: I hate, I despise your feasts, and I will not smell [a sweet odour] in your solemn assemblies.
texts.amo.5.22: For if ye offer up unto me burnt-offerings and your oblations, I will not accept [them]; neither will I regard the peace-offerings of your fatted beasts.
texts.amo.5.23: Take away from me the noise of thy songs, and I will not hear the melody of thy lutes;
texts.amo.5.24: but let judgment roll down as waters, and righteousness as an ever-flowing stream.
texts.amo.5.25: Did ye bring unto me sacrifices and oblations in the wilderness forty years, O house of Israel?
texts.amo.5.26: Yea, ye took up the tabernacle of your Moloch, and Chiun your images, the star of your god, which ye had made to yourselves;
texts.amo.5.27: and I will cause you to go into captivity beyond Damascus, saith Jehovah, whose name is the God of hosts.
texts.amo.6.1: Woe to them that are at ease in Zion and that are secure in the mountain of Samaria, the renowned of the first of the nations, to whom the house of Israel come.
texts.amo.6.2: Pass unto Calneh, and see; and from thence go to Hamath the great; and go down to Gath of the Philistines: are they better than these kingdoms? or their border greater than your border?
texts.amo.6.3: Ye that put far away the evil day, and cause the seat of violence to come near;
texts.amo.6.4: that lie upon beds of ivory, and stretch themselves upon their couches, and eat the lambs out of the flock, and the calves from the midst of the stall;
texts.amo.6.5: that chant to the sound of the lute, [and] invent them instruments of music, like David;
texts.amo.6.6: that drink wine in bowls, and anoint themselves with the chief ointments; but are not grieved for the breach of Joseph.
texts.amo.6.7: Therefore shall they now go captive, with the first that go captive, and the revelry of them that stretched themselves shall pass away.
texts.amo.6.8: The Lord Jehovah hath sworn by himself, saith Jehovah, the God of hosts, I abhor the pride of Jacob, and hate his palaces; and I will deliver up the city with all that is therein.
texts.amo.6.9: And it shall come to pass, if there remain ten men in one house, that they shall die.
texts.amo.6.10: And a man's uncle, and he that should burn him, shall take him up to bring out the bones from the house, and shall say unto him that is in the inner parts of the house, Is there yet [any] with thee? and he shall say, None. And he will say, Silence! for we may not make mention of Jehovah's name.
texts.amo.6.11: For behold, Jehovah commandeth, and he will smite the great house with breaches, and the little house with clefts.
texts.amo.6.12: Shall horses run upon the rock? will [men] plough [thereon] with oxen? For ye have turned judgment into gall, and the fruit of righteousness into wormwood,
texts.amo.6.13: -- ye that rejoice in a thing of nought, that say, Have we not taken to us power by our own strength?
texts.amo.6.14: For behold, O house of Israel, saith Jehovah the God of hosts, I will raise up against you a nation; and they shall afflict you from the entering in of Hamath unto the torrent of the Arabah.
texts.amo.7.1: Thus did the Lord Jehovah shew unto me; and behold, he formed locusts in the beginning of the shooting up of the latter growth, and behold, it was the latter growth after the king's mowings.
texts.amo.7.2: And it came to pass, when they had wholly eaten the grass of the land, that I said, O Lord Jehovah, forgive, I beseech thee! How shall Jacob arise? for he is small.
texts.amo.7.3: Jehovah repented for this: It shall not be, said Jehovah.
texts.amo.7.4: Thus did the Lord Jehovah shew unto me; and behold, the Lord Jehovah called to contend by fire; and it devoured the great deep, and ate up the inheritance.
texts.amo.7.5: Then said I, O Lord Jehovah, cease, I beseech thee! How shall Jacob arise? for he is small.
texts.amo.7.6: Jehovah repented for this: This also shall not be, said the Lord Jehovah.
texts.amo.7.7: Thus did he shew unto me; and behold, the Lord stood upon a wall [made] by a plumb-line, with a plumb-line in his hand.
texts.amo.7.8: And Jehovah said unto me, Amos, what seest thou? And I said, A plumb-line. And the Lord said, Behold, I will set a plumb-line in the midst of my people Israel: I will not again pass by them any more.
texts.amo.7.9: And the high places of Isaac shall be desolated, and the sanctuaries of Israel shall be laid waste; and I will arise against the house of Jeroboam with the sword.
texts.amo.7.10: Then Amaziah the priest of Bethel sent to Jeroboam king of Israel, saying, Amos hath conspired against thee in the midst of the house of Israel: the land is not able to bear all his words.
texts.amo.7.11: For thus Amos saith: Jeroboam shall die by the sword, and Israel shall certainly go into captivity out of his land.
texts.amo.7.12: And Amaziah said unto Amos, [Thou] seer, go, flee away into the land of Judah, and eat bread there, and prophesy there.
texts.amo.7.13: But prophesy not again any more at Bethel; for it is the king's sanctuary, and it is the house of the kingdom.
texts.amo.7.14: And Amos answered and said to Amaziah, I was no prophet, neither was I a prophet's son; but I was a herdman, and a gatherer of sycamore fruit.
texts.amo.7.15: And Jehovah took me as I followed the flock, and Jehovah said unto me, Go, prophesy unto my people Israel.
texts.amo.7.16: And now hear thou the word of Jehovah: Thou sayest, Prophesy not against Israel, and utter not [words] against the house of Isaac.
texts.amo.7.17: Therefore thus saith Jehovah: Thy wife shall be a harlot in the city, and thy sons and thy daughters shall fall by the sword, and thy land shall be divided with the line; and thou shalt die in a land that is unclean; and Israel shall certainly go into captivity, out of his land.
texts.amo.8.1: Thus did Jehovah shew unto me; and behold, a basket of summer-fruit.
texts.amo.8.2: And he said, Amos, what seest thou? And I said, A basket of summer-fruit. And Jehovah said unto me, The end is come upon my people Israel: I will not again pass by them any more.
texts.amo.8.3: And the songs of the palace shall be howlings in that day, saith the Lord Jehovah. The dead bodies shall be many; in every place they shall be cast forth. Silence!
texts.amo.8.4: Hear this, ye that pant after the needy, even to cause to fail the poor of the land,
texts.amo.8.5: saying, When will the new moon be gone, that we may sell corn? and the sabbath, that we may set forth wheat? making the ephah small and the shekel great, and falsifying the balances for deceit:
texts.amo.8.6: that we may buy the poor for silver, and the needy for a pair of shoes; and that we may sell the refuse of the wheat.
texts.amo.8.7: Jehovah hath sworn by the glory of Jacob, Certainly I will never forget any of their works.
texts.amo.8.8: Shall not the land tremble for this, and every one mourn that dwelleth therein? And it shall wholly rise up like the Nile; and it shall surge and sink down, as the river of Egypt.
texts.amo.8.9: And it shall come to pass in that day, saith the Lord Jehovah, that I will cause the sun to go down at noon, and I will darken the land in the clear day.
texts.amo.8.10: And I will turn your feasts into mourning, and all your songs into lamentation; and I will bring up sackcloth upon all loins, and baldness upon every head; and I will make it as the mourning for an only [son], and the end thereof as a bitter day.
texts.amo.8.11: Behold, days come, saith the Lord Jehovah, when I will send a famine in the land; not a famine of bread, nor a thirst for water, but of hearing the words of Jehovah.
texts.amo.8.12: And they shall wander from sea to sea, and from the north to the east; they shall run to and fro to seek the word of Jehovah, and shall not find it.
texts.amo.8.13: In that day shall the fair virgins and the young men faint for thirst;
texts.amo.8.14: they that swear by the sin of Samaria, and say, [As] thy god, O Dan, liveth! and, [As] the way of Beer-sheba liveth! even they shall fall, and never rise up again.
texts.amo.9.1: I saw the Lord standing upon the altar; and he said, Smite the chapiter that the thresholds may shake; and break all of them in pieces, in the head; and I will slay the last of them with the sword: he that fleeth of them shall not get away by flight, and he that escapeth of them shall not be delivered.
texts.amo.9.2: Though they dig into Sheol, thence shall my hand take them; and though they climb up to the heavens, thence will I bring them down;
texts.amo.9.3: and though they hide themselves on the top of Carmel, I will search and take them out thence; and though they be hid from my sight in the bottom of the sea, there will I command the serpent, and it shall bite them;
texts.amo.9.4: and though they go into captivity before their enemies, there will I command the sword, and it shall slay them: and I will set mine eyes upon them for evil, and not for good.
texts.amo.9.5: And the Lord Jehovah of hosts is he that toucheth the land, and it melteth, and all that dwell therein shall mourn; and it shall wholly rise up like the Nile, and sink down as the river of Egypt.
texts.amo.9.6: It is he that buildeth his upper chambers in the heavens, and hath founded his vault upon the earth; he that calleth for the waters of the sea, and poureth them out upon the face of the earth: Jehovah is his name.
texts.amo.9.7: Are ye not as children of the Ethiopians unto me, O children of Israel? saith Jehovah. Have not I brought up Israel out of the land of Egypt? and the Philistines from Caphtor, and the Syrians from Kir?
texts.amo.9.8: Behold, the eyes of the Lord Jehovah are upon the sinful kingdom, and I will destroy it from off the face of the earth: only that I will not utterly destroy the house of Jacob, saith Jehovah.
texts.amo.9.9: For behold, I command, and I will shake the house of Israel to and fro among all the nations, like as one shaketh [corn] in a sieve; yet shall not the least grain fall upon the earth.
texts.amo.9.10: All the sinners of my people shall die by the sword, who say, Evil shall not overtake nor befall us.
texts.amo.9.11: In that day will I raise up the tabernacle of David which is fallen, and close up the breaches thereof; and I will raise up its ruins, and I will build it as in the days of old:
texts.amo.9.12: that they may possess the remnant of Edom, and all the nations upon whom my name is called, saith Jehovah who doeth this.
texts.amo.9.13: Behold, the days come, saith Jehovah, when the ploughman shall overtake the reaper, and the treader of grapes him that soweth seed; and the mountains shall drop new wine, and all the hills shall melt.
texts.amo.9.14: And I will turn again the captivity of my people Israel, and they shall build the waste cities, and inhabit them; and they shall plant vineyards, and drink the wine thereof; and they shall make gardens, and eat the fruit of them.
texts.amo.9.15: And I will plant them upon their land, and they shall no more be plucked up out of their land which I have given them, saith Jehovah thy God.

texts.amo.1.1: Words of Amos -- who hath been among herdsmen of Tekoa -- that he hath seen concerning Israel, in the days of Uzziah king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam son of Joash king of Israel, two years before the shaking;
texts.amo.1.2: and he saith: Jehovah from Zion doth roar, And from Jerusalem giveth forth His voice, And mourned have pastures of the shepherds, And withered hath the top of Carmel!
texts.amo.1.3: And thus said Jehovah: For three transgressions of Damascus, And for four, I do not reverse it, Because of their threshing Gilead with sharp-pointed irons,
texts.amo.1.4: And I have sent a fire against the house of Hazael, And it hath consumed the palaces of Ben-Hadad.
texts.amo.1.5: And I have broken the bar of Damascus, And cut off the inhabitant from Bikat-Aven, And a holder of a sceptre from Beth-Eden, And removed have been the people of Aram to Kir, said Jehovah.
texts.amo.1.6: Thus said Jehovah: For three transgressions of Gaza, And for four, I do not reverse it, Because of their removing a complete captivity, To deliver up to Edom,
texts.amo.1.7: And I have sent a fire against the wall of Gaza, And it hath consumed her palaces;
texts.amo.1.8: And I have cut off the inhabitant from Ashdod, And a holder of a sceptre from Ashkelon, And have turned back My hand against Ekron, And perished have the remnant of the Philistines, Said the Lord Jehovah.
texts.amo.1.9: Thus said Jehovah: For three transgressions of Tyre, And for four, I do not reverse it, Because of their delivering up a complete captivity to Edom, And they remembered not the brotherly covenant,
texts.amo.1.10: And I have sent a fire against the wall of Tyre, And it hath consumed her palaces.
texts.amo.1.11: Thus said Jehovah: For three transgressions of Edom, And for four, I do not reverse it, Because of his pursuing with a sword his brother, And he hath destroyed his mercies, And tear perpetually doth his anger, And his wrath -- he hath kept it for ever,
texts.amo.1.12: And I have sent a fire against Teman, And it hath consumed palaces of Bozrah.
texts.amo.1.13: Thus said Jehovah: For three transgressions of the sons of Ammon, And for four, I do not reverse it, Because of their ripping up the pregnant ones of Gilead, To enlarge their border,
texts.amo.1.14: And I have kindled a fire against the wall of Rabbah, And it hath consumed her palaces, With a shout in a day of battle, With a whirlwind in a day of hurricane,
texts.amo.1.15: And gone hath their king in a removal, He and his heads together, said Jehovah!
texts.amo.2.1: Thus said Jehovah: For three transgressions of Moab, And for four, I do not reverse it, Because of his burning the bones of the king of Edom to lime,
texts.amo.2.2: And I have sent a fire against Moab, And it hath consumed the palaces of Kerioth, And dying with noise is Moab, With shouting, with voice of a trumpet.
texts.amo.2.3: And I have cut off a judge from her midst, And all its heads I slay with him, said Jehovah.
texts.amo.2.4: Thus said Jehovah: For three transgressions of Judah, And for four, I do not reserve it, Because of their loathing the law of Jehovah, And His statutes they have not kept, And their lies do cause them to err, After which their fathers did walk,
texts.amo.2.5: And I have sent a fire against Judah, And it hath consumed palaces of Jerusalem.
texts.amo.2.6: Thus said Jehovah: For three transgressions of Israel, And for four, I do not reverse it, Because of their selling for silver the righteous, And the needy for a pair of sandals.
texts.amo.2.7: Who are panting for the dust of the earth on the head of the poor, And the way of the humble they turn aside, And a man and his father go unto the damsel, So as to pollute My holy name.
texts.amo.2.8: And on pledged garments they stretch themselves near every altar, And the wine of fined ones they drink [in] the house of their gods.
texts.amo.2.9: And I -- I have destroyed the Amorite from before them, Whose height [is] as the height of cedars, And strong he [is] as the oaks, And I destroy his fruit from above, And his roots from beneath.
texts.amo.2.10: And I -- I have brought you up from the land of Egypt, And cause you to go in a wilderness forty years, To possess the land of the Amorite.
texts.amo.2.11: And I raise of your sons for prophets, And of your choice ones for Nazarites, Is not this true, O sons of Israel? An affirmation of Jehovah.
texts.amo.2.12: And ye cause the Nazarites to drink wine, And on the prophets ye have laid a charge, Saying, `Do not prophecy!'
texts.amo.2.13: Lo, I am pressing you under, As the full cart doth press for itself a sheaf.
texts.amo.2.14: And perished hath refuge from the swift, And the strong strengtheneth not his power, And the mighty delivereth not his soul.
texts.amo.2.15: And the handler of the bow standeth not, And the swift with his feet delivereth not [himself], And the rider of the horse delivereth not his soul.
texts.amo.2.16: And the courageous of heart among the mighty, Naked doth flee in that day, An affirmation of Jehovah!
texts.amo.3.1: Hear ye this word that Jehovah hath spoken concerning you, O sons of Israel, concerning all the family that I brought up from the land of Egypt, saying:
texts.amo.3.2: Only you I have known of all families of the land, Therefore I charge on you all your iniquities.
texts.amo.3.3: Do two walk together if they have not met?
texts.amo.3.4: Roar doth a lion in a forest and prey he hath none? Give out doth a young lion his voice from his habitation, If he hath not caught?
texts.amo.3.5: Doth a bird fall into a snare of the earth, And there is no gin for it? Doth a snare go up from the ground, And prey it captureth not?
texts.amo.3.6: Is a trumpet blown in a city, And do people not tremble? Is there affliction in a city, And Jehovah hath not done [it]?
texts.amo.3.7: For the Lord Jehovah doth nothing, Except He hath revealed His counsel unto His servants the prophets.
texts.amo.3.8: A lion hath roared -- who doth not fear? The Lord Jehovah hath spoken -- who doth not prophesy?
texts.amo.3.9: Sound ye unto palaces in Ashdod, And to palaces in the land of Egypt, and say: Be ye gathered on mountains of Samaria, And see many troubles within her, And oppressed ones in her midst.
texts.amo.3.10: And they have not known to act straightforwardly, An affirmation of Jehovah, Who are treasuring up violence and spoil in their palaces.
texts.amo.3.11: Therefore, thus said the Lord Jehovah: An adversary -- and surrounding the land, And he hath brought down from thee thy strength, And spoiled have been thy palaces.
texts.amo.3.12: Thus said Jehovah: As the shepherd delivereth from the lion's mouth Two legs, or a piece of an ear, So delivered are the sons of Israel, Who are sitting in Samaria on the corner of a bed, And in Damascus [on that of] a couch.
texts.amo.3.13: Hear ye and testify to the house of Jacob, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah, God of Hosts.
texts.amo.3.14: For in the day of My charging the transgressions of Israel on him, I have laid a charge on the altars of Beth-El, And cut off have been the horns of the altar, And they have fallen to the earth.
texts.amo.3.15: And I have smitten the winter-house with the summer-house, And perished have houses of ivory, And consumed have been many houses, An affirmation of Jehovah!
texts.amo.4.1: Hear this word, ye kine of Bashan, Who [are] in the mountain of Samaria, Who are oppressing the poor, Who are bruising the needy, Who are saying to their lords: `Bring in, and we do drink.'
texts.amo.4.2: Sworn hath the Lord Jehovah by His holiness, That lo, days are coming upon you, And he hath taken you away with hooks, And your posterity with fish-hooks.
texts.amo.4.3: And [by] breaches ye go forth, A woman [at that] over-against her, And ye have cast down the high place, An affirmation of Jehovah.
texts.amo.4.4: Enter ye Beth-El, and transgress, At Gilgal multiply transgression, And bring in every morning your sacrifices, Every third year your tithes.
texts.amo.4.5: And perfume with leaven a thank-offering, And proclaim willing gifts, sound ye! For so ye have loved, O sons of Israel, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah.
texts.amo.4.6: And I also -- I have given to you cleanness of teeth in all your cities, And lack of bread in all your places, And ye have not turned back unto Me, an affirmation of Jehovah.
texts.amo.4.7: And I also -- I have withheld from you the rain. While yet three months to harvest, And I have sent rain on one city, And on another city I do not send rain, One portion is rained on, And the portion on which it raineth not withereth.
texts.amo.4.8: And wandered have two or three cities, Unto the same city to drink water, And they are not satisfied, And ye have not turned back unto Me, An affirmation of Jehovah.
texts.amo.4.9: I have smitten you with blasting and with mildew, The abundance of your gardens and of your vineyards, And of your figs, and of your olives, Eat doth the palmer-worm, And ye have not turned back unto Me, An affirmation of Jehovah.
texts.amo.4.10: I have sent among you pestilence by the way of Egypt, I have slain by sword your choice ones, With your captive horses, And I cause the stink of your camps to come up -- even into your nostrils, And ye have not turned back unto Me, An affirmation of Jehovah.
texts.amo.4.11: I have overturned among you, Like the overturn by God of Sodom and Gomorrah, And ye are as a brand delivered from a burning, And ye have not turned back unto Me, An affirmation of Jehovah.
texts.amo.4.12: Therefore, thus I do to thee, O Israel, at last, Because this I do to thee, Prepare to meet thy God, O Israel.
texts.amo.4.13: For, lo, the former of mountains, and creator of wind, And the declarer to man what [is] His thought, He is making dawn obscurity, And is treading on high places of earth, Jehovah, God of Hosts, [is] His name!
texts.amo.5.1: Hear this word that I am bearing to you, A lamentation, O house of Israel:
texts.amo.5.2: `Fallen, not again to rise, hath the virgin of Israel, Left on her land -- she hath no raiser up.'
texts.amo.5.3: For thus said the Lord Jehovah: The city that is going out a thousand, Doth leave an hundred, And that which is going out an hundred, Doth leave ten to the house of Israel.
texts.amo.5.4: For thus said Jehovah to the house of Israel: Seek ye Me, and live,
texts.amo.5.5: And seek not Beth-El, and Gilgal enter not, And Beer-Sheba pass not through, For Gilgal doth utterly remove, And Beth-El doth become vanity.
texts.amo.5.6: Seek ye Jehovah, and live, Lest He prosper as fire [against] the house of Joseph, And it hath consumed, And there is no quencher for Beth-El.
texts.amo.5.7: Ye who are turning to wormwood judgment, And righteousness to the earth have put down,
texts.amo.5.8: The maker of Kimah and Kesil, And the turner to morning of death-shade, And day [as] night He hath made dark, Who is calling to the waters of the sea, And poureth them on the face of the earth, Jehovah [is] His name;
texts.amo.5.9: Who is brightening up the spoiled against the strong, And the spoiled against a fortress cometh.
texts.amo.5.10: They have hated a reprover in the gate, And a plain speaker they abominate.
texts.amo.5.11: Therefore, because of your trampling on the poor, And the tribute of corn ye take from him, Houses of hewn work ye have built, And ye do not dwell in them, Desirable vineyards ye have planted, And ye do not drink their wine.
texts.amo.5.12: For I have known -- many [are] your transgressions, And mighty your sins, Adversaries of the righteous, taking ransoms, And the needy in the gate ye turned aside.
texts.amo.5.13: Therefore is the wise at that time silent, For an evil time it [is].
texts.amo.5.14: Seek good, and not evil, that ye may live, And it is so; Jehovah, God of Hosts, [is] with you, as ye said.
texts.amo.5.15: Hate evil, and love good, And set up judgment in the gate, It may be Jehovah, God of Hosts, doth pity the remnant of Joseph.
texts.amo.5.16: Therefore, thus said Jehovah, God of Hosts, the Lord, In all broad places [is] lamentation, And in all out-places they say, `Alas, alas,' And called the husbandman to mourning, And to lamentation the skilful of wailing.
texts.amo.5.17: And in all vineyards [is] lamentation, For I pass into thy midst, said Jehovah.
texts.amo.5.18: Ho, ye who are desiring the day of Jehovah, Why [is] this to you -- the day of Jehovah? It is darkness, and not light,
texts.amo.5.19: As [when] one fleeth from the face of the lion, And the bear hath met him, And he hath come in to the house, And hath leant his hand on the wall, And the serpent hath bitten him.
texts.amo.5.20: Is not the day of Jehovah darkness and not light, Even thick darkness that hath no brightness?
texts.amo.5.21: I have hated -- I have loathed your festivals, And I am not refreshed by your restraints.
texts.amo.5.22: For though ye cause burnt-offerings and your presents to ascend to Me, I am not pleased, And the peace-offering of your fatlings I behold not.
texts.amo.5.23: Turn aside from Me the noise of thy songs, Yea, the praise of thy psaltery I hear not.
texts.amo.5.24: And roll on as waters doth judgment, And righteousness as a perennial stream.
texts.amo.5.25: Sacrifices and offering did ye bring nigh to Me, In a wilderness forty years, O house of Israel?
texts.amo.5.26: And ye bare Succoth your king, and Chiun your images, The star of your god, that ye made for yourselves.
texts.amo.5.27: And I removed you beyond Damascus, Said Jehovah, God of Hosts [is] His name.
texts.amo.6.1: Wo [to] those secure in Zion, And those confident in the mount of Samaria, The marked of the chief of the nations, And come to them have the house of Israel.
texts.amo.6.2: Pass ye over [to] Calneh and see, And go thence [to] Hamath the great, And go down [to] Gath of the Philistines, Are [they] better than these kingdoms? Greater [is] their border than your border?
texts.amo.6.3: Who are putting away the day of evil, And ye bring nigh the seat of violence,
texts.amo.6.4: Who are lying down on beds of ivory, And are spread out on their couches, And are eating lambs from the flock, And calves from the midst of the stall,
texts.amo.6.5: Who are taking part according to the psaltery, Like David they invented for themselves instruments of music;
texts.amo.6.6: Who are drinking with bowls of wine, And [with] chief perfumes anoint [themselves], And have not been pained for the breach of Joseph.
texts.amo.6.7: Therefore now they remove at the head of the captives, And turned aside is the mourning-feast of stretched-out ones.
texts.amo.6.8: Sworn hath the Lord Jehovah by Himself, An affirmation of Jehovah, God of Hosts: I am abominating the excellency of Jacob, And his high places I have hated, And I have delivered up the city and its fulness.
texts.amo.6.9: And if there are left ten persons in one house, It hath come to pass -- that they have died.
texts.amo.6.10: And lifted him up hath his loved one, even his burner, To bring forth the bones from the house, And he said to him who [is] in the sides of the house, `Is there yet with thee?' And he said, `None,' then he said, `Hush! Save to make mention of the name of Jehovah.'
texts.amo.6.11: For lo, Jehovah is commanding, And He hath smitten the great house [with] breaches, And the little house [with] clefts.
texts.amo.6.12: Do horses run on a rock? Doth one plough [it] with oxen? For ye have turned to gall judgment, And the fruit of righteousness to wormwood.
texts.amo.6.13: O ye who are rejoicing at nothing, Who are saying, `Have we not by our strength taken to ourselves horns?'
texts.amo.6.14: Surely, lo, I am raising against you a nation, O house of Israel, An affirmation of Jehovah, God of Hosts, And they have oppressed you from the coming in to Hamath, Unto the stream of the desert.
texts.amo.7.1: Thus hath the Lord Jehovah shewed me, and lo, He is forming locusts at the beginning of the ascending of the latter growth, and lo, the latter growth [is] after the mowings of the king;
texts.amo.7.2: and it hath come to pass, when it hath finished to consume the herb of the land, that I say: `Lord Jehovah, forgive, I pray Thee, How doth Jacob arise -- for he [is] small?'
texts.amo.7.3: Jehovah hath repented of this, `It shall not be,' said Jehovah.
texts.amo.7.4: Thus hath the Lord Jehovah shewed me, and lo, the Lord Jehovah is calling to contend by fire, and it consumeth the great deep, yea, it hath consumed the portion, and I say:
texts.amo.7.5: `Lord Jehovah, cease, I pray Thee, How doth Jacob arise -- for he [is] small?'
texts.amo.7.6: Jehovah hath repented of this, `It also shall not be,' said the Lord Jehovah.
texts.amo.7.7: Thus hath He shewed me, and lo, the Lord is standing by a wall [made according to] a plumb-line, and in His hand a plumb-line;
texts.amo.7.8: and Jehovah saith unto me, `What art thou seeing, Amos?' And I say, `A plumb-line;' and the Lord saith: `Lo, I am setting a plumb-line in the midst of My people Israel, I do not add any more to pass over to it.
texts.amo.7.9: And desolated have been high places of Isaac, And sanctuaries of Israel are wasted, And I have risen against the house of Jeroboam with a sword.'
texts.amo.7.10: And Amaziah priest of Beth-El sendeth unto Jeroboam king of Israel, saying, `Amos hath conspired against thee in the midst of the house of Israel; the land is not able to bear all his words,
texts.amo.7.11: for thus said Amos: By sword die doth Jeroboam, And Israel certainly removeth from off its land.'
texts.amo.7.12: And Amaziah saith unto Amos, `Seer, go flee for thee unto the land of Judah, and eat there bread, and there thou dost prophesy;
texts.amo.7.13: and [at] Beth-El do not add to prophesy any more, for it [is] the king's sanctuary, and it [is] the royal house.'
texts.amo.7.14: And Amos answereth and saith unto Amaziah, `I [am] no prophet, nor a prophet's son [am] I, but a herdsman I [am], and a cultivator of sycamores,
texts.amo.7.15: and Jehovah taketh me from after the flock, and Jehovah saith unto me, Go, prophesy unto My people Israel.
texts.amo.7.16: And now, hear a word of Jehovah: thou art saying, Do not prophesy against Israel, nor drop [any thing] against the house of Isaac,
texts.amo.7.17: therefore thus said Jehovah: Thy wife in the city doth go a-whoring, And thy sons and thy daughters by sword do fall, And thy land by line is apportioned, And thou on an unclean land diest, And Israel certainly removeth from off its land.'
texts.amo.8.1: Thus hath the Lord Jehovah shewed me, and, lo, a basket of summer-fruit.
texts.amo.8.2: And He saith, `What art thou seeing, Amos?' and I say, `A basket of summer-fruit.' And Jehovah saith unto me: `The end hath come unto My people Israel, I do not add any more to pass over to it.
texts.amo.8.3: And howled have songstresses of a palace in that day, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah, Many [are] the carcases, into any place throw -- hush!
texts.amo.8.4: Hear this, ye who are swallowing up the needy, To cause to cease the poor of the land,
texts.amo.8.5: Saying, When doth the new moon pass, And we sell ground corn? And the sabbath, and we open out pure corn? To make little the ephah, And to make great the shekel, And to use perversely balances of deceit.
texts.amo.8.6: To purchase with money the poor, And the needy for a pair of sandals, Yea, the refuse of the pure corn we sell.
texts.amo.8.7: Sworn hath Jehovah by the excellency of Jacob: `I forget not for ever any of their works.
texts.amo.8.8: For this doth not the land tremble, And mourned hath every dweller in it? And come up as a flood hath all of it. And it hath been cast out, and hath sunk, Like the flood of Egypt.
texts.amo.8.9: And it hath come to pass in that day, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah, I have caused the sun to go in at noon, And caused darkness on the land in a day of light,
texts.amo.8.10: And have turned your festivals to mourning, And all your songs to lamentation, And caused sackcloth to come up on all loins, And on every head -- baldness, And made it as a mourning [of] an only one, And its latter end as a day of bitterness.
texts.amo.8.11: Lo, days are coming, An affirmation of the Lord Jehovah, And I have sent a famine into the land, Not a famine of bread, nor a thirst of water But of hearing the words of Jehovah.
texts.amo.8.12: And they have wandered from sea unto sea, And from north even unto east, They go to and fro to seek the word of Jehovah, And they do not find.
texts.amo.8.13: In that day faint do the fair virgins, And the young men, with thirst.
texts.amo.8.14: Those swearing by the guilt of Samaria, And have said, Live doth thy god, O Dan, And, Live doth the way of Beer-Sheba, And they have fallen -- and rise not again!'
texts.amo.9.1: I have seen the Lord standing by the altar, and He saith: `Smite the knob, and the thresholds shake, And cut them off by the head -- all of them, And their posterity with a sword I do slay, Not flee to them doth the fleer, Nor escape to them doth a fugitive.
texts.amo.9.2: If they dig through into sheol, From thence doth My hand take them, And if they go up the heavens, From thence I cause them to come down.
texts.amo.9.3: And if they be hid in the top of Carmel, From thence I search out, and have taken them, And if they be hid from Mine eyes in the bottom of the sea, From thence I command the serpent, And it hath bitten them.
texts.amo.9.4: And if they go into captivity before their enemies, From thence I command the sword, And it hath slain them, And I have set Mine eye on them for evil, And not for good.
texts.amo.9.5: And [it is] the Lord, Jehovah of Hosts, Who is striking against the land, and it melteth, And mourned have all the inhabitants in it, And come up as a flood hath all of it, And it hath sunk -- like the flood of Egypt.
texts.amo.9.6: Who is building in the heavens His upper chambers; As to His troop, Upon earth He hath founded it, Who is calling for the waters of the sea, And poureth them out on the face of the land, Jehovah [is] His name.
texts.amo.9.7: As sons of Cushim are ye not to Me? O sons of Israel -- an affirmation of Jehovah. Israel did I not bring up out of the land of Egypt? And the Philistines from Caphtor, and Aram from Kir?
texts.amo.9.8: Lo, the eyes of the Lord Jehovah [are] on the sinful kingdom, And I have destroyed it from off the face of the ground, Only, I destroy not utterly the house of Jacob, An affirmation of Jehovah.
texts.amo.9.9: For lo, I am commanding, And I have shaken among all the nations the house of Israel, As [one] doth shake with a sieve, And there falleth not a grain [to] the earth.
texts.amo.9.10: By sword die do all sinners of My people, Who are saying, `Not overtake, or go before, For our sakes, doth evil.'
texts.amo.9.11: In that day I raise the tabernacle of David, that is fallen, And I have repaired their breaches, And its ruins I do raise up, And I have built it up as in days of old.
texts.amo.9.12: So that they possess the remnant of Edom, And all the nations on whom My name is called, An affirmation of Jehovah -- doer of this.
texts.amo.9.13: Lo, days are coming -- an affirmation of Jehovah, And come nigh hath the ploughman to the reaper, And the treader of grapes to the scatterer of seed, And the mountains have dropt juice, And all the hills do melt.
texts.amo.9.14: And I have turned back [to] the captivity of My people Israel, And they have built desolate cities, and inhabited, And have planted vineyards, and drunk their wine, And made gardens, and eaten their fruit.
texts.amo.9.15: And I have planted them on their own ground, And they are not plucked up any more from off their own ground, That I have given to them, said Jehovah thy God!

texts.amo.1.1: Las palabras de Amós, que fue entre los pastores de Tecua, las cuales vio sobre Israel en días de Osías, rey de Judá, y en días de Jeroboam, hijo de Joas, rey de Israel, dos años antes del terremoto.
texts.amo.1.2: Y dijo: Jehová bramará desde Sión, y desde Jerusalem dará su voz, y las habitaciones de los pastores pondrán luto, y la cumbre del Carmelo se secará.
texts.amo.1.3: Así dijo Jehová: Por tres pecados de Damasco, y por el cuarto, no la convertiré; porque trillaron con trillos de hierro a Galaad.
texts.amo.1.4: Y meteré fuego en la casa de Hazael, y consumirá los palacios de Ben-adad.
texts.amo.1.5: Y quebraré la barra de Damasco, y talaré los moradores de Bicat-aven, y los gobernadores de Bet-eden; y el pueblo de Siria será traspasado en Kir, dijo Jehová.
texts.amo.1.6: ¶ Así dijo Jehová: Por tres pecados de Gaza, y por el cuarto, no la convertiré; porque llevó cautiva una cautividad entera para entregar los a Edom.
texts.amo.1.7: Y meteré fuego en el muro de Gaza, y quemará sus palacios.
texts.amo.1.8: Y talaré los moradores de Azoto, y los gobernadores de Ascalón; y tornaré mi mano sobre Accarón, y los residuos de los Palestinos perecerán, dijo el Señor Jehová.
texts.amo.1.9: ¶ Así dijo Jehová: Por tres pecados de Tiro, y por el cuarto, no la convertiré; porque entregaron la cautividad entera a Edom, y no se acordaron del concierto de hermano.
texts.amo.1.10: Y meteré fuego en el muro de Tiro, y consumirá sus palacios.
texts.amo.1.11: ¶ Así dijo Jehová: Por tres pecados de Edom, y por el cuarto, no la convertiré; porque persiguió a cuchillo a su hermano, y rompió sus misericordias; y con su furor le ha robado siempre, y ha guardado el enojo perpetuamente.
texts.amo.1.12: Y meteré fuego en Temán, y consumirá los palacios de Bosra.
texts.amo.1.13: ¶ Así dijo Jehová: Por tres pecados de los hijos de Amón, y por el cuarto, no los convertiré; porque rompieron los montes de Galaad, para ensanchar su término.
texts.amo.1.14: Y encenderé fuego en el muro de Rabba, y consumirá sus palacios como con estruendo en día de batalla, como con tempestad en día tempestuoso.
texts.amo.1.15: Y su rey irá en cautividad, él y sus príncipes todos, dijo Jehová.
texts.amo.2.1: Así dijo Jehová: Por tres pecados de Moab, y por el cuarto, no le convertiré; porque quemó los huesos del rey de Idumea hasta tornarlos en cal.
texts.amo.2.2: Y meteré fuego en Moab, y consumirá los palacios de Cariot, y morirá Moab, en alboroto, en estrépito, y sonido de trompeta.
texts.amo.2.3: Y quitaré el juez de en medio de él, y a todos sus príncipes mataré con él, dijo Jehová.
texts.amo.2.4: ¶ Así dijo Jehová: Por tres pecados de Judá, y por el cuarto, no la convertiré; porque menospreciaron la ley de Jehová, y no guardaron sus ordenanzas; y sus mentiras los hicieron errar, en pos de las cuales anduvieron sus padres.
texts.amo.2.5: Y meteré fuego en Judá, el cual consumirá los palacios de Jerusalem.
texts.amo.2.6: Así dijo Jehová: Por tres pecados de Israel, y por el cuarto, no le convertiré; porque vendieron por dinero al justo, y al pobre por un par de zapatos:
texts.amo.2.7: Que anhelan porque haya un polvo de tierra sobre la cabeza de los pobres, y tuercen la carrera de los humildes; y el hombre y su padre entraron a una moza, profanando mi santo nombre.
texts.amo.2.8: Y sobre las ropas empeñadas se acuestan junto a cualquier altar; y el vino de los penados beben en la casa de sus dioses.
texts.amo.2.9: Y yo destruí al Amorreo delante de ellos, cuya altura era como la altura de los cedros, y fuerte como un alcornoque; y destruí su fruto arriba, y sus raíces abajo.
texts.amo.2.10: Y yo os hice a vosotros subir de la tierra de Egipto, y trájeos por el desierto cuarenta años, para que poseyeseis la tierra del Amorreo.
texts.amo.2.11: Y levanté de vuestros hijos para profetas, y de vuestros mancebos para que fuesen Nazareos: ¿No es esto así, hijos de Israel? dijo Jehová.
texts.amo.2.12: Y vosotros distes de beber vino a los Nazareos, y a los profetas mandasteis, diciendo: No profeticéis.
texts.amo.2.13: Pues he aquí que yo os apretaré en vuestro lugar, como se aprieta el carro lleno de haces.
texts.amo.2.14: Y la huida perecerá del ligero, y el fuerte no esforzará a su fuerza, ni el valiente escapará su vida.
texts.amo.2.15: Y el que toma el arco no estará en pie, ni el ligero de pies escapará, ni el que cabalga en caballo escapará su vida.
texts.amo.2.16: El esforzado entre esforzados, aquel día huirá desnudo, dijo Jehová.
texts.amo.3.1: Oíd esta palabra que ha hablado Jehová contra vosotros, hijos de Israel: contra toda la familia que hice subir de la tierra de Egipto. Dice así:
texts.amo.3.2: A vosotros solamente he conocido de todas las familias de la tierra, por tanto visitaré contra vosotros todas vuestras maldades.
texts.amo.3.3: ¿Andarán dos juntos, si no estuvieren de concierto?
texts.amo.3.4: ¿Bramará en el monte el león, sin hacer presa? ¿el leoncillo dará su bramido desde su morada, si no prendiere?
texts.amo.3.5: ¿Caerá el ave en el lazo de la tierra, sin haber armador? ¿Alzarse ha el lazo de la tierra, si no se ha prendido algo?
texts.amo.3.6: ¿Tocarse ha la trompeta en la ciudad, y el pueblo no se alborotará? ¿Habrá algún mal en la ciudad, el cual Jehová no haya hecho?
texts.amo.3.7: Porque no hará nada el Señor Jehová, sin que revele su secreto a sus siervos los profetas.
texts.amo.3.8: Bramando el león, ¿quién no temerá? hablando el Señor Jehová, ¿quién no profetizará?
texts.amo.3.9: Hacéd pregonar sobre los palacios de Azoto, y sobre los palacios de tierra de Egipto, y decíd: Congregáos sobre los montes de Samaria, y ved muchas opresiones en medio de ella, y muchas violencias en medio de ella.
texts.amo.3.10: Y no saben hacer lo recto, dijo Jehová, atesorando rapiñas y despojos en sus palacios.
texts.amo.3.11: Por tanto el Señor Jehová dijo así: Enemigo vendrá que cercará la tierra; y derribará de ti tu fortaleza, y tus palacios serán saqueados.
texts.amo.3.12: Así dijo Jehová: De la manera que el pastor escapa de la boca del león dos piernas, o la punta de una oreja, así escaparán los hijos de Israel, que moran en Samaria, al rincón de la cama, y al canto del lecho.
texts.amo.3.13: Oíd, y protestád en la casa de Jacob, dijo Jehová, Dios de los ejércitos:
texts.amo.3.14: Que el día que visitaré las rebeliones de Israel sobre él, visitaré también sobre los altares de Bet-el; y serán cortados los cuernos del altar, y caerán a tierra.
texts.amo.3.15: Y heriré la casa del invierno con la casa del verano, y las casas de marfil perecerán; y muchas casas serán taladas, dijo Jehová.
texts.amo.4.1: Oíd esta palabra, vacas de Basán, que estáis en el monte de Samaria, que oprimís los pobres: que quebrantáis los menesterosos: que decís a sus señores: Traed y beberemos.
texts.amo.4.2: El Señor Jehová juró por su santidad, que he aquí vienen días sobre vosotros en que os llevará en anzuelos, y a vuestros descendientes en barquillos de pescador.
texts.amo.4.3: Y saldrán por los portillos la una en pos de la otra, y seréis echadas del palacio, dijo Jehová.
texts.amo.4.4: Id a Bet-el, y rebelád en Gálgala: aumentád la rebelión, y traed de mañana vuestros sacrificios, y vuestros diezmos cada tres años.
texts.amo.4.5: Y ofrecéd sacrificio de acción de gracias con pan leudo, y pregonád sacrificios voluntarios, pregonád: pues que así queréis, hijos de Israel, dijo el Señor Jehová.
texts.amo.4.6: ¶ Yo también os di limpieza de dientes en todas vuestras ciudades, y falta de pan en todos vuestros pueblos: y no os tornasteis a mí, dijo Jehová.
texts.amo.4.7: Y también yo os detuve la lluvia tres meses antes de la segada; e hice llover sobre una ciudad, y sobre otra ciudad no hice llover: sobre una parte llovió, y la parte sobre la cual no llovió, se secó.
texts.amo.4.8: Y venían dos, tres ciudades a una ciudad para beber agua, y no se hartaban; y no os tornasteis a mí, dijo Jehová.
texts.amo.4.9: Heríos con viento solano, y oruga, vuestros muchos huertos, y vuestras viñas, y vuestros higuerales; y vuestros olivares comió la langosta; y nunca os tornasteis a mí, dijo Jehová.
texts.amo.4.10: Envié en vosotros mortandad en el camino de Egipto: maté a cuchillo vuestros mancebos, con cautiverio de vuestros caballos; e hice subir el hedor de vuestros reales hasta vuestras narices; y nunca os tornasteis a mí, dijo Jehová.
texts.amo.4.11: Trastornéos, como cuando Dios trastornó a Sodoma y a Gomorra, y fuisteis como tizón escapado del fuego; y nunca os tornasteis a mí, dijo Jehová.
texts.amo.4.12: Por tanto de esta manera haré a ti, o! Israel; y porque te he de hacer esto, aparéjate para venir al encuentro a tu Dios, o! Israel.
texts.amo.4.13: Porque he aquí, el que forma los montes, y cria el viento, y denuncia al hombre su pensamiento; el que hace a las tinieblas mañana, y pasa sobre las alturas de la tierra, Jehová Dios de los ejércitos es su nombre.
texts.amo.5.1: Oíd esta palabra, porque yo levanto endecha sobre vosotros, casa de Israel.
texts.amo.5.2: Cayó, nunca más se levantará la virgen de Israel: fue dejada sobre su tierra, no hay quien la levante.
texts.amo.5.3: Porque así dijo el Señor Jehová: la ciudad que sacaba mil, quedará con ciento; y la que sacaba ciento, quedará con diez en la casa de Israel.
texts.amo.5.4: Porque así dijo Jehová a la casa de Israel: Buscádme, y vivíd.
texts.amo.5.5: Y no busquéis a Bet-el, ni entréis en Gálgala, ni paséis a Beer-seba; porque Gálgala será llevada en cautividad, y Bet-el será deshecha.
texts.amo.5.6: Buscád a Jehová, y vivíd; porque no hienda, como fuego, a la casa de José, y la consuma, y no haya en Bet-el quien lo apague.
texts.amo.5.7: Que convierten en ajenjo el juicio, y dejan en tierra la justicia.
texts.amo.5.8: El que hace el Arcturo y el Orión, y las tinieblas vuelve en mañana, y hace oscurecer el día en noche: el que llama a las aguas de la mar, y las derrama sobre la haz de la tierra, Jehová es su nombre.
texts.amo.5.9: El que da esfuerzo al robador sobre el fuerte, y que el robador venga contra la fortaleza.
texts.amo.5.10: Aborrecieron en la puerta al reprensor, y al que hablaba lo recto abominaron.
texts.amo.5.11: Por tanto por vuestro molestar al pobre, y recibís de él carga de trigo, edificasteis casas de sillares, mas no las habitaréis: plantasteis hermosas viñas, mas no beberéis el vino de ellas.
texts.amo.5.12: Porque sabido he vuestras muchas rebeliones, y vuestros gruesos pecados: que afligen al justo, y reciben cohecho, y a los pobres en la puerta hacen perder su causa.
texts.amo.5.13: Por lo cual el prudente en tal tiempo calla, porque el tiempo es malo.
texts.amo.5.14: Buscád lo bueno, y no lo malo, para que viváis: porque así será con vosotros Jehová Dios de los ejércitos, como decís.
texts.amo.5.15: Aborrecéd el mal, y amád el bien, y ponéd juicio en la puerta: quizá Jehová Dios de los ejércitos habrá piedad de la resta de José.
texts.amo.5.16: Por tanto así dijo Jehová Dios de los ejércitos, el Señor: En todas las plazas habrá llanto, y en todas las calles dirán; ¡Ay, ay! y al labrador llamarán a lloro, y a endecha, a los que supieren endechar.
texts.amo.5.17: Y en todas las viñas habrá llanto, porque pasaré por medio de ti, dijo Jehová.
texts.amo.5.18: ¡Ay de los que desean el día de Jehová! ¿para qué queréis este día de Jehová? Tinieblas, y no luz.
texts.amo.5.19: Como el que huye de delante del león, y se topa con el oso; o, si entrare en casa, y arrime su mano a la pared, y le muerda la culebra.
texts.amo.5.20: ¿El día de Jehová, no es tinieblas, y no luz: oscuridad, que no tiene resplandor?
texts.amo.5.21: Aborrecí, abominé vuestras solemnidades, y no me darán buen olor vuestras congregaciones.
texts.amo.5.22: Y si me ofreciereis holocaustos y vuestros presentes, no los recibiré: ni miraré a los sacrificios pacíficos de vuestros engordados.
texts.amo.5.23: Quita de mí la multitud de tus cantares; y las salmodias de tus instrumentos no oiré.
texts.amo.5.24: Y corra como las aguas el juicio, y la justicia como arroyo impetuoso.
texts.amo.5.25: ¿Habéisme ofrecido sacrificios y presente en el desierto en cuarenta años, casa de Israel?
texts.amo.5.26: Y ofrecisteis a Sicut, vuestro rey, y a Quión, vuestros ídolos, estrella de vuestros dioses que os hicisteis.
texts.amo.5.27: Haréos pues trasportar de ese cabo de Damasco, dijo Jehová, Dios de los ejércitos es su nombre.
texts.amo.6.1: ¡Ay de los reposados en Sión, y de los confiados en el monte de Samaria, nombrados entre las mismas naciones principales, las cuales vendrán sobre ellos, o! casa de Israel!
texts.amo.6.2: Pasád a Calanna, y mirád; y de allí id a la gran Emat; y descendéd a Get de los Palestinos, ¿si son aquellos reinos mejores que estos reinos? ¿si su término es mayor que vuestro término?
texts.amo.6.3: Los que dilatáis el día malo, y acercáis la silla de iniquidad:
texts.amo.6.4: Los que duermen en camas de marfil, y se extienden sobre sus lechos, y comen los corderos del rebaño, y los becerros de en medio del engordadero:
texts.amo.6.5: Los que hacen de garganta al son de la flauta, e inventan instrumentos músicos, como David:
texts.amo.6.6: Los que beben vino en tazones, y se ungen con los ungüentos más preciosos, ni se afligen por el quebrantamiento de José.
texts.amo.6.7: Por tanto ahora pasarán en el principio de los que pasaren; y se acercará el lloro de los extendidos.
texts.amo.6.8: El Señor Jehová juró por su alma, Jehová Dios de los ejércitos dijo: Tengo en abominación la grandeza de Jacob, y sus palacios aborrezco; y la ciudad, y su plenitud entregaré al enemigo.
texts.amo.6.9: Y acontecerá que si diez hombres quedaren en una casa, morirán.
texts.amo.6.10: Y su tio tomará a cada uno, y le quemará, para sacar los huesos de casa; y dirá al que estará en los rincones de la casa: ¿Hay aun alguno contigo? y dirá: No. Y dirá: Calla, que no conviene hacer memoria del nombre de Jehová.
texts.amo.6.11: Porque he aquí que Jehová mandará, y herirá de hendeduras la casa mayor; y la casa menor de aberturas.
texts.amo.6.12: ¿Correrán los caballos por las piedras? ¿ararán con vacas? ¿por qué habéis vosotros tornado el juicio en veneno, y el fruto de justicia en ajenjo?
texts.amo.6.13: Los que os alegráis en nada: los que decís: ¿Nosotros no nos tomamos cuernos con nuestra fortaleza?
texts.amo.6.14: Porque he aquí que yo levantaré sobre vosotros, o! casa de Israel, dijo Jehová Dios de los ejércitos, nación, que os apretará desde la entrada de Emat, hasta el arroyo del desierto.
texts.amo.7.1: El Señor Jehová me mostró así; y he aquí que él criaba langostas al principio que comenzaba a crecer el heno tardío. Y he aquí que el heno tardío creció después de las segadas del rey.
texts.amo.7.2: Y acaeció que como acabó de comer la yerba de la tierra, yo dije: Señor Jehová, perdona ahora: ¿quién levantará a Jacob? porque es pequeño.
texts.amo.7.3: Arrepintióse Jehová de esto: no será, dijo Jehová.
texts.amo.7.4: El Señor Jehová después me mostró así; y he aquí que llamaba para juzgar por fuego el Señor Jehová: y consumió un gran abismo, y consumió la parte.
texts.amo.7.5: Y dije: Señor Jehová, cesa ahora: ¿quién levantará a Jacob? porque es pequeño.
texts.amo.7.6: Arrepintióse Jehová de esto: Tampoco esto no será, dijo el Señor Jehová.
texts.amo.7.7: Enseñóme también así: He aquí que el Señor estaba sobre un muro edificado a plomo de albañil; y tenía en su mano un plomo de albañil.
texts.amo.7.8: Jehová entonces me dijo: ¿Qué ves Amós? Y dije: Un plomo de albañil. Y el Señor dijo: He aquí que yo pongo plomo de albañil en medio de mi pueblo Israel: nunca más le pasaré.
texts.amo.7.9: Y los altares de Isaac serán destruidos, y los santuarios de Israel serán asolados, y levantarme he con espada sobre la casa de Jeroboam.
texts.amo.7.10: ¶ Entonces Amasías sacerdote de Bet-el envió a decir a Jeroboam, rey de Israel: Amós ha conjurado contra ti en medio de la casa de Israel: la tierra no puede ya sufrir todas sus palabras.
texts.amo.7.11: Porque así ha dicho Amós: Jeroboam morirá a cuchillo; e Israel pasará de su tierra en cautividad.
texts.amo.7.12: Y Amasías dijo a Amós: Vidente, vete, y huye a tierra de Judá, y come allá tu pan, y profetiza allá.
texts.amo.7.13: Y no profetices más en Bet-el; porque es santuario del rey, y cabecera del reino.
texts.amo.7.14: Y Amós respondió, y dijo a Amasías: No soy profeta, ni soy hijo de profeta: mas soy boyero, y cogedor de cabrahígos.
texts.amo.7.15: Y Jehová me tomó de tras el ganado; y díjome Jehová: Vé, y profetiza a mi pueblo Israel.
texts.amo.7.16: Ahora pues, oye palabra de Jehová: Tú dices: No profetices contra Israel, ni hables contra la casa de Isaac.
texts.amo.7.17: Por tanto así dijo Jehová: Tu mujer fornicará en la ciudad, y tus hijos y tus hijas caerán a cuchillo, y tu tierra será partida por suertes; y tu morirás en tierra inmunda; e Israel será traspasado de su tierra.
texts.amo.8.1: Jehová me enseñó así; y he aquí un canastillo de fruta de verano.
texts.amo.8.2: Y dijo: ¿Qué ves Amós? Y dije: Un canastillo de fruta de verano. Y Jehová me dijo: Venido ha el fin sobre mi pueblo Israel: nunca más le pasaré.
texts.amo.8.3: Y los cantores del templo aullarán en aquel día, dijo el Señor Jehová: los cuerpos muertos serán aumentados en todo lugar, echados en silencio.
texts.amo.8.4: Oíd esto los que tragáis los menesterosos, y taláis los pobres de la tierra,
texts.amo.8.5: Diciendo: Cuando pasare el mes, venderemos el trigo; y pasada la semana, abriremos el pan; y achicaremos la medida, y engrandeceremos el precio, y falsearemos el peso engañoso.
texts.amo.8.6: Y compraremos los pobres por dinero, y los necesitados por un par de zapatos; y venderemos las ahechaduras del trigo.
texts.amo.8.7: Jehová juró por la gloria de Jacob: Que no me olvidaré para siempre de todas sus obras.
texts.amo.8.8: ¶ ¿No se ha de estremecer la tierra sobre esto? ¿y todo habitador de ella, no llorará? y toda subirá como un río, y será arrojada, y será hundida como el río de Egipto.
texts.amo.8.9: Y acaecerá en aquel día, dijo el Señor Jehová, que haré que se ponga el sol al mediodía, y la tierra cubriré de tinieblas en el día claro.
texts.amo.8.10: Y tornaré vuestras fiestas en lloro, y todos vuestros cantares en endechas, y haré poner saco sobre todos lomos, y peladura sobre toda cabeza; y tornarla he como en llanto de unigénito, su postrimería como día amargo.
texts.amo.8.11: He aquí que vienen días, dijo el Señor Jehová, en los cuales enviaré hambre en la tierra: no hambre de pan, ni sed de agua, mas de oír palabra de Jehová.
texts.amo.8.12: E irán vagabundos desde la una mar hasta la otra mar: desde el norte hasta el oriente discurrirán buscando palabra de Jehová, y no la hallarán.
texts.amo.8.13: En aquel tiempo las doncellas hermosas, y los mancebos desmayarán de sed.
texts.amo.8.14: Los que juran por el pecado de Samaria, y dicen: Vive tú, Dios de Dan; y: Vive el camino de Beer-seba: caerán, y nunca más se levantarán.
texts.amo.9.1: Ví al Señor que estaba sobre el altar, y dijo: Hiere el umbral, y estremézcanse las puertas; y córtalos en piezas la cabeza de todos; y el postrero de ellos mataré a cuchillo: no habrá de ellos quien huya, ni quien escape.
texts.amo.9.2: Si cavaren hasta el infierno, de allá los tomará mi mano; y si subieren hasta el cielo, de allá los haré descender:
texts.amo.9.3: Y si se escondieren en la cumbre del Carmelo, allí los buscaré, y los tomaré; y si se escondieren de delante de mis ojos en el profundo de la mar, allí mandaré a la culebra, y morderlos ha:
texts.amo.9.4: Y si fueren en cautiverio delante de sus enemigos, allí mandaré a la espada, y matarlos ha; y pondré sobre ellos mis ojos para mal, y no para bien.
texts.amo.9.5: El Señor Jehová de los ejércitos, que toca la tierra, y se derretirá, y llorarán todos los que en ella moran; y subirá toda como un río, y será hundida como el río de Egipto.
texts.amo.9.6: El edificó en el cielo sus grados, y su conjunto fundó sobre la tierra: él llama las aguas de la mar, y las derrama sobre la haz de la tierra: Jehová es su nombre.
texts.amo.9.7: Hijos de Israel, ¿no me sois vosotros como hijos de Etiopes? dijo Jehová: ¿No hice yo subir a Israel de la tierra de Egipto, y a los Palestinos de Caftor, y a los Siros de Kir?
texts.amo.9.8: He aquí que los ojos del Señor Jehová están contra el reino pecador; y yo le asolaré de la haz de la tierra: mas no destruiré del todo la casa de Jacob, dijo Jehová.
texts.amo.9.9: Porque he aquí que yo mandaré, y haré que la casa de Israel sea zarandada en todas las naciones, como se zaranda el grano en un harnero, y no cae una chinica en la tierra.
texts.amo.9.10: A espada morirán todos los pecadores de mi pueblo, que dicen: No se acercará, ni se anticipará el mal por causa nuestra.
texts.amo.9.11: En aquel día yo levantaré la cabaña de David caída, y cerraré sus portillos, y levantaré sus ruinas, y edificarle he como en el tiempo pasado:
texts.amo.9.12: Para que aquellos sobre los cuales es llamado mi nombre, posean la resta de Idumea, y a todas las naciones, dijo Jehová que hace esto.
texts.amo.9.13: ¶ He aquí que vienen días, dijo Jehová, en que el que ara se llegará al segador, y el pisador de las uvas al que lleva la simiente; y los montes destilarán mosto, y todos los collados se derretirán.
texts.amo.9.14: Y tornaré el cautiverio de mi pueblo Israel; y edificarán las ciudades asoladas, y habitarlas han; y plantarán viñas, y beberán el vino de ellas; y harán huertos, y comerán el fruto de ellos.
texts.amo.9.15: Y plantarlos he sobre su tierra, y nunca más serán arrancados de su tierra, la cual yo les dí, dijo Jehová Dios tuyo.

texts.amo.1.1: The words of Amos, who was among the herdmen of Tekoa,—of which (words) he had vision concerning Israel, in the days of Uzziah king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam son of Joash, king of Israel, two years before the earthquake.
texts.amo.1.2: So then he said—Yahweh, out of Zion, will roar, and, out of Jerusalem, will utter his voice,—and the pastures of the shepherds, shall mourn, and the top of Carmel, be dried up.
texts.amo.1.3: Thus, saith Yahweh, Because of three transgressions of Damascus, and because of four, will I not turn it back,—Because, with threshing instruments of iron, they have threshed Gilead.
texts.amo.1.4: Therefore will send a fire, into the house of Hazael,—which shall devour the palaces of Ben- hadad;
texts.amo.1.5: And I will break the bolt of Damascus, and cut off the inhabitant out of the plain of Aven, and the holder of the sceptre out of the house of Eden,—and the people of Syria, shall be exiled, unto Kir, saith Yahweh.
texts.amo.1.6: Thus, saith Yahweh, Because of three transgressions of Gaza, and because of four, will I not turn it back,—Because of their taking into exile the whole body of exiles, to deliver to Edom,
texts.amo.1.7: Therefore will I send a fire upon the wall of Gaza,—which shall devour the palaces thereof;
texts.amo.1.8: And I will cut off the inhabitant out of Ashdod, and the holder of the sceptre out of Ashkelon,—and will turn my hand against Ekron, So shall perish the remnant of the Philistines, saith My Lord, Yahweh.
texts.amo.1.9: Thus, saith Yahweh, Because of three transgressions of Tyre, and because of four, will I not turn it back,—Because of their delivering up the whole body of exiles to Edom, and they remembered not the brotherly covenant,
texts.amo.1.10: Therefore will I send a fire upon the wall of Tyre,—which shall devour the palaces thereof.
texts.amo.1.11: Thus, saith Yahweh, Because of three transgressions of Edom, and because of four, will I not turn it back,—Because he pursued, with the sword, his brother, and stifled his compassions, and his anger tare in pieces evermore, and, his indignation, kept watch perpetually,
texts.amo.1.12: Therefore will I send a fire into Teman,—which shall devour the palaces of Bozrah.
texts.amo.1.13: Thus, saith Yahweh, Because of three transgressions of the sons of Ammon, and because of four, will I not turn it back,—Because of their ripping up the pregnant women of Gilead, that they might enlarge their own boundary,
texts.amo.1.14: Therefore will I kindle a fire upon the wall of Rabbah, which shall devour the palaces thereof,—with a war-cry in the day of battle, with tempest in the day of storm-wind;
texts.amo.1.15: And Milcom shall go into exile,—he and his rulers together, saith Yahweh.
texts.amo.2.1: Thus, saith Yahweh, Because of three transgressions of Moab, and because of four, will I not turn it back,—Because he burned the bones of the King of Edom to lime,
texts.amo.2.2: Therefore will I send a fire into Moab, which shall devour the palaces of Kerioth—and Moab, shall die with tumult, with war- cry, with the sound of a horn;
texts.amo.2.3: And I will cut off the judge out of her midst, and, all her rulers, will I slay with him, saith Yahweh.
texts.amo.2.4: Thus, saith Yahweh, Because of three transgressions of Judah, and because of four, will I not turn it back,—Because they have rejected the law of Yahweh, and, his statutes, have not kept, but their falsehoods, have led them astray, after the which their fathers, did walk,
texts.amo.2.5: Therefore will I send a fire upon Judah,—which shall devour the palaces of Jerusalem.
texts.amo.2.6: Thus, saith Yahweh, Because of three transgressions of Israel, and because of four, will I not turn it back,—Because they have sold—for silver—the righteous, and the needy—for a pair of shoes:
texts.amo.2.7: Who strive to bring the dust of the earth on the head of the poor, and, the way of the oppressed, they pervert,—Yea, a man and his own father, go in unto the maid, to profane my holy Name!
texts.amo.2.8: And, on pledged garments, they recline, beside every altar,—and, exacted wine, do they drink, in the house of their God.
texts.amo.2.9: Yet it was, I, who destroyed the Amorite, from before them, whose height was, like the height of cedars, and, strong, was he, like the oaks,—but I destroyed his fruit above, and his roots beneath.
texts.amo.2.10: And it was, I, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt,—and led you in the desert, forty years, to take possession of the land of the Amorites;
texts.amo.2.11: And I raised up, of your sons, for prophets, and, of your young men, for Nazirites,—Was it not even so, ye sons of Israel? Demandeth Yahweh;
texts.amo.2.12: And yet ye caused the Nazirites to drink wine,—and, on the prophet, laid ye command, saying, Ye shall not prophesy!
texts.amo.2.13: Lo! I, am pressed under you,—as a full cart is pressed by its sheaves,
texts.amo.2.14: Therefore shall flight, perish, from the swift, and, the mighty, shall not invigorate his strength,—nor shall, the hero, escape with his life;
texts.amo.2.15: Nor, he that handleth the bow, make a stand, and, the swift on his feet, shall not escape,—nor, he that rideth on a horse, escape with his life:
texts.amo.2.16: Nay, he that is stout in his heart, among heroes, naked, shall flee, in that day, Declareth Yahweh.
texts.amo.3.1: Hear ye this word, which Yahweh hath spoken, concerning you, ye sons of Israel,—concerning the whole family which I brought up out of the land of Egypt saying:—
texts.amo.3.2: Only you, have I acknowledged, of all the families of the ground, For this cause, will I visit upon you all your iniquities.
texts.amo.3.3: Can two walk together,—except they meet?
texts.amo.3.4: Will a lion roar in the forest, when, prey, he hath none? Will a young lion utter his voice out of his den, when he hath made no capture?
texts.amo.3.5: Will a bird fall upon a net to the earth, when there is no, snare, for it? Will a net rise from the ground, when it hath, captured nothing?
texts.amo.3.6: Or a horn be blown in a city, and, a people, not tremble? Or calamity happen in a city, and, Yahweh, not have wrought with effect?
texts.amo.3.7: Surely My Lord Yahweh, will do, nothing,—except he have disclosed his secret unto his servants, the prophets!
texts.amo.3.8: A lion, hath roared, Who will not fear? My Lord Yahweh, hath spoken, Who can forbear to prophesy?
texts.amo.3.9: Announce it over the palaces in Ashdod, and over the palaces in the land of Egypt,—and say ye—Gather yourselves together upon the mountains of Samaria, and behold ye—the great disorders in the midst thereof, and the oppressed within her.
texts.amo.3.10: Therefore do they not know how to do right, Declareth Yahweh, who are treasuring up violence and spoil in their palaces.
texts.amo.3.11: Therefore—Thus, saith My Lord, Yahweh, An adversary! Yea round about the land,—and he who shall bring down, from thee, thy strength, And spoiled shall be thy palaces.
texts.amo.3.12: Thus, saith Yahweh, Just as a shepherd rescueth, out of the mouth of the lion, a couple of shankbones, or the tip of an ear, so, shall be rescued the sons of Israel, who are tarrying in Samaria, in the corner of the divan, and on the damask of the luxurious couch.
texts.amo.3.13: Hear ye and bear witness, throughout the house of Jacob,—Commandeth My Lord, Yahweh, God of hosts:
texts.amo.3.14: That, in the day I visit the transgressions of Israel upon him, then will I punish, concerning the altars of Bethel, So shall the horns of the altar, be broken off, and they shall fall to the ground;
texts.amo.3.15: And I will smite the winter house along with the summer house,—and the houses of ivory, shall be destroyed! and the great houses, shall disappear, Declareth Yahweh.
texts.amo.4.1: Hear ye this word, ye heifers of Bashan, that are in the mountain of Samaria, who oppress the poor, who crush the needy,—who say to their lords, Bring in, and let us drink!
texts.amo.4.2: Sworn hath My Lord, Yahweh, by his own holiness, That lo! days, are coming upon you,—when he will take you away with hooks, and your followers with fishhooks;
texts.amo.4.3: And, through fissures, shall ye go out, every woman, straight before her,—and ye shall be thrust forth towards the castle, Declareth Yahweh.
texts.amo.4.4: Enter ye Bethel, and transgress, At Gilgal, cause transgression, to abound,—Yea, carry in, every morning, your sacrifices, every three days, your tithes;
texts.amo.4.5: Yea, burn thou incense, of that which is leavened, as a thank-offering, and proclaim ye freewill-offerings, let them be known,—for, so, ye love [to have it], ye sons of Israel, Declareth My Lord, Yahweh.
texts.amo.4.6: Moreover also, I, have given you cleanness of teeth throughout all your cities, and want of bread throughout all your dwelling-places,—Yet have ye not returned unto me, Declareth Yahweh.
texts.amo.4.7: Moreover also, I, have withholden from you the abundant rain, when yet there were only three mouths to the harvest, Or I might rain upon one city, and, on another city, might not rain,—One portion, would be rained upon, and, the portion whereupon it should not rain, would be dried up;
texts.amo.4.8: Then would two or three cities totter to one city to drink water, without being satisfied,—Yet have ye not returned unto me, Declareth Yahweh.
texts.amo.4.9: I have smitten you with blight and with mildew, When your gardens and your vineyards and your fig-trees and your olive-trees have increased, the creeping locust would devour them,—Yet have ye not returned unto me, Declareth Yahweh.
texts.amo.4.10: I have sent among you pestilence, in the manner of Egypt, I have slain, with the sword, your young men, and therewith have been taken captive your horses, And I have caused to ascend—the stench of your camps, even into your own nostrils, Yet ye have not returned unto me, Declareth Yahweh.
texts.amo.4.11: I have made an overthrew among you, like the divine overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah, and ye have become like a brand snatched out of the burning,—Yet hate ye not returned unto me, Declareth Yahweh.
texts.amo.4.12: Therefore, thus, will I do unto thee, O Israel,—Because this thing I will do unto thee, Prepare to meet thy God, O Israel.
texts.amo.4.13: For lo! He that fashioned the mountains, and created the wind, and who telleth the son of earth what is his thought, who turneth dawn into darkness, and marcheth upon the high places of the earth, Yahweh, God of hosts, is his name!
texts.amo.5.1: Hear ye this word, which, I, am taking up concerning you—even a dirge, O house of Israel.
texts.amo.5.2: She hath fallen—she cannot again rise, the virgin, Israel,—she lieth forsaken on her soil, there is none to raise her up.
